entries.text: Fall seven times, stand up eight.
The bamboo that bends is stronger than the oak that resists.
None of us is as smart as all of us.
If you want to go fast, go alone. If you want to go far, go together.
Smooth seas do not make skillful sailors.
When the music changes, so does the dance.
However long the night, the dawn will break.
The child who is not embraced by the village will burn it down to feel its warmth.
Do not look where you fell, but where you slipped.
The axe forgets; the tree remembers.
Many hands make light work.
Still waters run deep.
This too shall pass.
Fortune favors the bold.
Dripping water hollows out stone, not through force but through persistence.
Rome wasn't built in a day.
A smooth sea never made a skilled sailor.
The best time to plant a tree was twenty years ago. The second best time is now.
A bird does not sing because it has an answer. It sings because it has a song.
Tension is who you think you should be. Relaxation is who you are.
Be not afraid of growing slowly, be afraid only of standing still.
Give a man a fish and you feed him for a day. Teach a man to fish and you feed him for a lifetime.
Talk does not cook rice.
A closed mind is like a closed book; just a block of wood.
He who asks a question is a fool for five minutes; he who does not ask remains a fool forever.
Know thyself.
Nothing in excess.
Everything flows.
No man ever steps in the same river twice, for it's not the same river and he's not the same man.
A soft answer turns away wrath.
May the road rise to meet you. May the wind be always at your back.
Praise the ripe field, not the green corn.
What the eyes don't see, the heart doesn't grieve over.
Little by little, one walks far.
The mountain has a thousand paths, but the summit is the same.
